dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: ...I just can't believe it. Would someone really take a Kamera into the Maison Gestion itself, and simply strut about taking pictures of everyone and anything?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: It is ridiculous! Everyone knows, everyone should know, that that is how secrets get leaked! It is common sense!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: If common sense was common, Mr. Iaune, then the Maison Gestion could simply disband tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: I shall leave this to you. Have them sign the document, just like I taught you, and return it to me before the weekend.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: I still have to handle the expense receipts. Carsix keeps hassling me about it.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: But, Mr. Roialte, just who should I be looking for? We don't have an office specifically in charge of Kameras.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Uh... I trust your judgment. Now hurry up and take care of this, so we can each really enjoy the weekend! I'm going to go take care of other things. Hop to it, kid!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Yessir, Mr. Roialte.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Roialte leaves in a leisurely manner...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Huh? Hello, hello. It looks, though, you are not a member of the staff here at the Maison Gestion.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I am currently busy with official business. Should you have any inquiries, please ask Ms. Cornelia. She's right over there.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: She will provide you with a chair and a cup of tea. Please have a seat, and I will come find you after I am done.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the big rush?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's... It's actually a simple matter, but dealing with it is quite complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: The office I work in has received a notice instructing us to draft a letter to the other offices.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: The content was something like, staff are forbidden from bringing Kameras into the Maison Gestion and taking pictures, except for work purposes, in order to avoid leakage of secret information.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does telling me about the letter's contents constitute leaking secrets?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: No, certainly not. If anyone really had used a Kamera to take a photo of documents, and it resulted in a leak, then this would certainly be a confidential matter.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: However, "maybe someone will use a Kamera to take a picture of documents in order to leak them" is not a secret. After all, that's a possibility that everyone is aware of.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I feel dizzy...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Think about it this way: If you are guarding a secret, then the secret you are guarding certainly cannot be revealed.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: But the fact that "you are guarding a secret" itself may not be considered secret.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: After all, if even the fact that "you are guarding a secret" is considered a secret, then you will fall into an endless cycle of keeping the secret of keeping secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your wording is an endless cycle!

choices.text: I'm curious who is in charge of this matter...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: That is where this matter becomes complicated. There is no office in the entire Maison Gestion that is directly charged with managing Kameras.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Mr. Semaine says that I should ask Mr. Gattineo. Their work is related to confidential matters, and thus they should be the first to be made aware.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: But Mr. Roialte says that I should ask Difor, as he is in charge of all matters related to the staff of the Maison Gestion.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Were we to make a new rule that all staff of the Maison Gestion cannot bring Kameras to work, we'd have to let them know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... That's complicated... Why are there so many different people responsible for different things? What happens if you can't remember?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: That's why each of us carries a thick notepad. Though even with the notes, I'm still not sure who I should look for now...

choices.text: Then who is responsible for this?
